'''2009 Bespin Regionals Ryan Ritter LS We Have A Plan (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Ritter]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan (V) / They Will Be Lost And Confused (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|OVS16-11-We_Have_A_Plan-remaster.webp|label=We Have A Plan (V) / They Will Be Lost And Confused (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Evil League Of Evil
* '''Username:''' CoolioZC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
